lines.en: - What do we do? - What do you mean, what do we do?
Twins!
Twins!
- Taylor, you're panicking. - Uh-huh. Join me, won't you?
Okay, what do you say we keep one and then just, like, have an option on the other one?
- Taylor, we can't split them up. - Why not?
We could give each of them half a medallion,
and then years later, they'll find each other...
...and be reunited.
I mean, that's a great day for everybody.
Okay, what if the person who adopts the other one is horrible?
What if they're not?
What if it's adopted by a king?
Yeah, because I hear the king is looking to adopt.
Monica, we are not ready to have two babies.
That doesn't matter.
We have waited so long for this. I don't care if it's two babies.
I don't care if it's three babies.
I don't care if the entire cast of Eight Is Enough comes out of there.
I don't care if it's two babies.
I don't care if it's three babies.
I don't care if it's three babies.
